clips.title: The story
paras: Night Web's Hollow is an early assignment from Executor Arren to clear out the spiders infesting a nearby gold mine northwest of Deathknell. Facing critical shortages of raw materials, the fledgling Forsaken need the mine's wealth to sustain their settlement and war effort. Newly risen recruits are sent into the tangled cavern to cull the arachnid infestation piece by piece.

Survival for the newly risen Forsaken involves more than just defending against the Scourge and Scarlet crusaders. Building a fledgling society requires raw resources, and precious metals like gold were scarce in northern Lordaeron even at the height of the Alliance's strength. Executor Arren, overseeing operations in Deathknell, recognizes that the Forsaken cannot hope to arm, equip, and establish themselves without secured wealth.

Directly northwest of the cemetery grounds lies Night Web's Hollow, a natural cavern containing a viable gold vein. Unfortunately, monstrous arachnids have overrun the tunnels, filling the depths with thick webbing and deadly venom. Lacking the seasoned troops to conduct a full-scale purge, Arren relies on fresh recruits to whittle down the young and adult spiders until mining crews can eventually burn away the webs and extract the ore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: One of our greatest struggles is obtaining the natural resources we need to survive. Gold was scarce even in the height of the Alliance's power.

There is a gold mine to the northwest that has been overrun with spiders. We need gold from the mine, but we can't very well get it while the spiders are crawling around in there. I've not much manpower to commit to the task, so we'll just have to do it little by little.
Get up there and see what you can do for us, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Be wary of the spiders' venom, friend. If you feel a sharp burning, you may want to have it looked at.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm, well, it's a start. It'll take a few weeks or months to fully clean out the infestation. After that, we'll have to get down there with some torches to burn away the webbing.
You've done your duty well, friend, I'm sure I can find something else for you to do.
